name: B10-0074/2024 (ESN) – The democratic backsliding and threats to political pluralism in Georgia
title: Resolution on the democratic backsliding and threats to political pluralism in Georgia
part_text:
This text is a proposed resolution from a political group, not a law. It asks the European Union to stop criticising Georgia's government and to stay out of its internal affairs. It says claims of democratic backsliding are unfounded and defends Georgia's law on foreign influence. It also asks the EU to respect Georgia's sovereignty, its Orthodox Christian traditions and its right to set its own policies. It is an opinion statement with no legal force.

- Nothing changes yet; the Parliament has not voted on this text.
- It targets EU institutions and the Georgian government and public.
- Next, the Parliament would debate and vote on whether to adopt it.
